title: Syntagma sacrae theologiae (Liber II Cap. 5 densify complete)
author: Ludwig Crocius
edition: Syntagma sacrae theologiae (Bremen: Berthold Villerian, 1636). VD17 14:684303C. SLUB id335860389. Liber II Cap. 5 De statu animae a corpore separata COMPLETE (mid PHYS 356-mid-372 before CAPUT SEXTUM).
blurb: Ludwig Crocius — Book II Chapter 5 On the state of the soul separated from the body, from the 1636 Bremen Latin. Densify COMPLETE (mid PHYS 356–mid-372): Cap. 5 title; death as judgment; common status and four plagues; soul not extinguished / does not sleep; proper status joy vs torment; no third place; OT fathers and limbus; Origen vs papal purgatory — Cap. 5 close. Cap. 6 starts mid PHYS 372 (De hujus mundi fine). Liber I Cap.1–11 and Liber II Cap.1–4 COMPLETE (english not modified).
